selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: original segmented topology and lack of shared subnet
selected_evidence.summary: node1 eth1/eth2 had no IP (unconfigured segments), node2/node3 eth1 existed but was disconnected/unconfigured; only shared network was the unrelated eth0 mgmt subnet.

selected_evidence.requirement: L2 bridge created on node1 joining the two segments
selected_evidence.summary: br1 created on node1 with eth1 and eth2 as members, both in forwarding state, no IP assigned to br1.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 configured on a shared subnet
selected_evidence.summary: node2 eth1=192.168.50.11/24 and node3 eth1=192.168.50.12/24 configured and persisted via nmcli/ifcfg with ONBOOT=yes.

selected_evidence.requirement: Hosts reach each other directly with node1 forwarding frames (not routing)
selected_evidence.summary: Bidirectional ping between 192.168.50.11 and .12 succeeded with TTL=64 (unchanged, proving no routed hop); node1's bridge FDB dynamically learned both peers' real MAC addresses on their respective bridge ports, confirming transparent L2 forwarding.

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline capture (boot identity + service/data health) on all nodes
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id and boot time on node1/node2/node3 plus bridge/interface state prior to any restarts.

selected_evidence.requirement: Bridge configuration persisted so it survives a node1 restart
selected_evidence.summary: Created and enabled systemd oneshot unit br1-setup.service on node1 to recreate br1 at every boot, since the live kernel bridge state would not otherwise survive a reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; boot_id changed from e85bf011... to 76bd5dea... with new uptime; br1-setup.service active, bridge ports forwarding again, core SONiC services active, and node2->node3 ping succeeded post-restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from d72bd4ec... to 1200c70a..., boot time updated to 2026-09-05 03:57; eth1 static IP persisted and ping to node3 succeeded post-restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from 809708f3... to a6f54ccd..., boot time updated to 2026-09-05 03:57; eth1 static IP persisted, ping to node2 succeeded, and node1's bridge FDB re-learned both peer MACs confirming full cluster L2 recovery.
